screens.name: Ask — expanded personal context and retrieved disclosure

screens.name: Ask — named recipient with collapsed context

screens.name: Named person — populated, corrected, empty-disabled and constrained

screens.name: Question and custom-answer forms — populated and constrained

screens.name: Expanded question editor — tall and constrained

screens.name: Expanded custom-answer editor — tall, constrained and character limit

screens.name: Follow-up card 1 — unselected and enlarged

screens.name: Follow-up card 3 — unselected and enlarged

limitations: All scores are provisional browser grades based on the attached stills, chronological filmstrips and supplied runtime report; no additional files, source, prior evaluations or live app were inspected.
Corresponding normal, enlarged, transition and closely related states are grouped under named entries; deductions apply to the specific variants identified in their evidence.
Reported browser interaction checks support interaction scores; visible appearance alone is not treated as proof of functionality.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, actual OS sharing, native notifications and native performance remain unverified and did not independently lower browser scores.
The filmstrips demonstrate sampled composition changes, not continuous motion smoothness or frame rate; timing claims come only from the separate supplied runtime measurements.
Independent painted depth layers and true parallax cannot be established from these captures; visible crossfades do not by themselves prove spatial camera travel.
Synthetic wording and dense fixtures were treated as test content, not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
Billing and navigator.share are simulated, Circles is offline, and the browser reminder explicitly schedules nothing; connected or native success is not certified.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence: content below a viewport or inside a demonstrated scrollable field is not automatically unreachable.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across every screen and component, primarily because of scene integration, dense centered reading and enlarged-view hierarchy.

Aesthetic and functional means and weighted overall grades can be calculated from each item's six dimensions, excluding genuinely inapplicable null values; no full/native 9 or 10 certification is made.
topFixes: Integrate Sky's selector and repeated wood/parchment panels with the painted furniture through consistent perspective, contact shadows and lighting.
Improve room-to-room spatial continuity: the sampled transitions currently read more as backdrop replacements than movement through connected spaces.
Shorten centered passage groups and strengthen section/caption hierarchy in explanations, answers and sources without removing stored text.
Compact enlarged context, invitation, profile and policy groups so task controls and secondary exits require less vertical searching.
Make internal input and URL continuation cues clearer than the partially clipped letterforms at paper edges.
Keep destination labels visibly attached to Home's room miniatures at enlarged text.
